integrity: The equilibrium reduction, characteristic polynomial, Hurwitz determinant, imaginary-axis exclusion, and Routh index were reconstructed from the printed ODE. A dependency-free exact algebra replay is bundled as verify.py.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a local equilibrium-spectrum classification on the positive parameter octant. It does not prove or classify the reported periodic/chaotic attractors, their basins, or the circuit realization.
title: Universal index-two hyperbolicity in a four-dimensional Sprott-B feedback flow
